interpretation: Completion fraction includes all 1,000 trials. Finish-time statistics include only successful flights.
Terminal reasons describe the simulator stopping rule; they do not establish a collision or its cause.
Timing is specific to the evaluation machine and environment. The simulator counter determines deadline compliance.
The original course report described 95/100 completions and 73.35 s mean successful completion time; this later evaluation used a separate course cohort, so it is not a paired same-seed comparison.
The difference between 95% and 97.1% completion has not been shown to be statistically significant.
This compact archive contains scalar outcomes and configuration, not the original raw telemetry. The presented observer and rotor plots cannot be independently recomputed from this JSON alone.
